sections.heading: First 10 minutes: safety and 911
paragraphs: A collision on Major highways and arterials in West Valley City or surface streets in West Valley City can escalate quickly. If vehicles are drivable and it is safe, move to a shoulder or parking lot. Turn on hazard lights.

Call 911 when anyone reports pain, airbags deploy, fluids leak, or traffic is blocked. West Valley City County / local jurisdiction dispatch will route West Valley City police or state patrol depending on location.
list: Stay inside the vehicle with seatbelts on if traffic passes closely at highway speed

sections.heading: West Valley City documentation checklist
paragraphs: Photograph all vehicles, license plates, VIN stickers, skid marks, traffic signals, and visible injuries. West Valley City insurers expect timestamped photos.

sections.heading: Medical care within 24 hours
paragraphs: West Valley City has West Valley City area hospitals and emergency departments among its major facilities. Verify the nearest trauma center if injuries may be serious.

sections.heading: Utah reporting rules
paragraphs: Utah requires crash reporting when injuries, death, or significant property damage occur. Minimum liability limits are 25/65/15.
Cooperate with officers; request a copy of the report through the investigating agency. If police do not respond, check https://www.udot.utah.gov/ for self-report thresholds.

sections.heading: Insurance notification without hurting your claim
paragraphs: Notify your carrier with basic facts — date, location, vehicles involved. Decline recorded statements until you understand your coverage and injuries.
Utah no-fault rules may limit lawsuits unless injuries exceed thresholds — verify with counsel.
